subject: CS350
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selections are from a mix of highly-rated channels like Gate Smashers, kudvenkat, and Socratica, chosen for their clear, often visual, explanations of complex topics. The Arabic selections are dominated by Dr. Mohamed El Desouki's channel, which consistently provides the most popular and academically rigorous content for these university-level topics. No suitable Arabic video was found for 'Handling NULLs and 3-valued Logic'.

coverage.note: No candidates found for this topic in Arabic.

videos.title: Relational Model - NULL Values in SQL | Database Tutorial 2d
videos.topic_ar: التعامل مع القيم الفارغة والمنطق ثلاثي القيم
videos.filter_reason: This video from a computer science channel directly explains that SQL uses a three-valued logic where comparisons with NULL result in 'unknown', which is the core concept students struggle with.

videos.title: Lec-81: Correlated Subquery in SQL with Example | Imp for Placements, GATE, NET & SQL certification
videos.filter_reason: From a highly-regarded educational channel, this video focuses specifically on correlated subqueries with high-quality examples, addressing the most difficult part of the topic for students.

videos.title: After update trigger   Part 44
videos.filter_reason: A classic, highly-viewed tutorial that provides a deep explanation of the 'inserted' and 'deleted' logical tables, which is the mechanism for accessing the NEW/OLD context that students find confusing.

videos.title: Group by in sql server - Part 11
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed classic video explicitly explains the difference between the WHERE and HAVING clauses, directly addressing the common point of confusion for students.

videos.title: SQL Joins Explained  |¦| Joins in SQL |¦| SQL Tutorial
videos.filter_reason: This video provides exceptionally clear visual explanations using Venn diagrams to show how different join types work, which is perfect for understanding how rows are filtered or retained.

videos.title: 63 - Oracle Subqueries - Nested Queries تعليم أوراكل
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive academic lecture from a top-tier Arabic channel that covers nested and correlated queries in depth, making it ideal for university-level understanding.

videos.title: | SQL Server - 2nd Course | - | Triggers - After Trigger , Instead of Triggers |
videos.filter_reason: This is the most popular and comprehensive Arabic video on the topic, clearly explaining trigger types and the crucial 'inserted'/'deleted' context tables (equivalent to NEW/OLD).

videos.title: 30 - | MS SQL Server For Beginners | - | Group by .. Having|
videos.filter_reason: An in-depth lecture from a highly respected academic channel that thoroughly covers GROUP BY and HAVING, clarifying the distinction from WHERE for students.

videos.title: 26 - | MS SQL Server For Beginners | - | Join Tables | - |Inner Join & Natural Join |
videos.filter_reason: This is the most-viewed and authoritative Arabic video on the topic, providing a foundational academic lecture on how joins work, which is perfect for building strong relational thinking.
